授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 三次元の空間や立体を二次元平面上に表現したり、二次元平面上に描かれた図形から空間や立体を読み取る方法についての講義と演習を行う。毎回、講義のあと演習を行う。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Technical drawings are the foundation of engineering and architectural design. From modern engineering achievements such as the H2A rocket, the Honshu–Shikoku Bridge, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building to the historic wooden buildings of Horyu-ji Temple, virtually all three-dimensional structures are designed and constructed based on information conveyed through two-dimensional technical drawings. For students pursuing engineering and related disciplines, the ability to represent three-dimensional objects accurately on two-dimensional drawings, as well as to interpret and visualize three-dimensional forms from such drawings, is a fundamental professional skill. This course aims to develop these competencies through a combination of lectures and practical drawing exercises.
In the second half of the course, students apply these principles to more advanced topics, including edge views, intersections, and developments of solids. The course also introduces other projection methods, including axonometric, oblique, indexed, and perspective projections, together with the graphical representation of shadows, as required by different engineering disciplines.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Geometry, projection, view, intersection, drawing, graphic science
